rot.ideia.ex1.e1: You have a rook and two pawns. Black has only one pawn. Lots of material, but you need a plan.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: The plan: the rook cuts the king off, the pawns go up together, and the black pawn does not run free.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: Start with the rook: close the file right next to the black king, between it and your pawns.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Close the file with the rook, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! The rook closes the d-file, and the black king stays away from your pawns.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The rook goes to d1 and closes the file right next to the black king.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.b2b4.1: The pawn left alone, before the fence.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.b2b4.2: The black king runs towards the pawns.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.b2b4.3: Let's go back: first the rook cuts, then the pawns walk.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1a5.1: It is check, but the rook closes nothing.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1a5.2: The black king goes towards the pawns.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1a5.3: Let's go back: first the rook cuts, then the pawns walk.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: That move does not close the file next to the king. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Close the file with the rook, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: Done: the black king cannot cross to your pawns' side.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: Now the black pawn has run to f3. If it reaches f1, it becomes a queen.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: Stop the black pawn, without leaving one of your pawns undefended near the black king.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Stop the black pawn, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: Perfect! The king attacks the black pawn, and next move it can capture it.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The king goes to f2, next to the black pawn. From there it captures it.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.b2b4.1: The pawn left alone, away from the other.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.b2b4.2: The black king captures the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.b2b4.3: Let's go back: stop the black pawn with the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.c2c4.1: The pawn went near the black king, unprotected.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.c2c4.2: The black king captures the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.c2c4.3: Let's go back: stop the black pawn with the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a3.1: The rook attacks the pawn, but it moves first.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a3.2: The pawn advances with check and threatens to become a queen.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a3.3: Let's go back: stop the black pawn with the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That move does not stop the black pawn. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Stop the black pawn, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: Remember: with lots of material, first take away the opponent's chances. Then advance.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Now I will show the pawns going up together and the king stopping the black pawn.
rot.demos.juntos.e1: The rook already cuts off the black king. Watch the pawns go up together.
rot.demos.juntos.l2: The black king waits: the rook on d1 does not let it enter the d-file.
rot.demos.juntos.l3: The other goes up beside it.
rot.demos.juntos.l4: It cannot step on the d-file: the rook attacks every square on it.
rot.demos.juntos.l5: The b4 pawn protects the c5 pawn: if anything captures on c5, the b4 pawn takes back.
rot.demos.juntos.l7: Side by side again. That way they go up to promotion.
rot.demos.parar.e1: The black king is trapped beyond the d-file. The black pawn tries to run alone.
rot.demos.parar.l2: The white king goes to it, to capture it.
rot.demos.parar.l3: The black king cannot help: it cannot step on the d-file.
rot.demos.parar.l4: The king captures the pawn. Now only White has pawns to promote.
rot.demos.parar.l5: Now it's your turn to play: stop the black pawn, cut the king off and push your pawns.
rot.pratica.parar.enunciado: The black pawn wants to promote on g1. Bring your king near g1, on a square the pawn does not attack.
rot.pratica.parar.fim: Well done. The black pawn cannot get past your king.
rot.pratica.parar.err.d2d4: The black pawn runs. Deal with it first. Try again.
rot.pratica.parar.err.c2c4: The black pawn runs. Deal with it first. Try again.
rot.pratica.converter.enunciado: Follow the plan: cut the king off, deal with the black pawn, promote a pawn and give mate.
rot.pratica.converter.fim: Excellent! You converted the advantage calmly, like a professional.
